status: B1/B2 upheld, B3 falsified as written (its mechanism confirmed)
finding: 1-(1-p)^N holds only for independent loss; bursty loss at the same marginal drop rate costs up to 0.312 resolvability, the deficit shrinks with more opportunities (+0.312 at N=4 to +0.052 at N=12), and a burst covering the window collapses the N chances into a single draw. Independence is itself a coverage-like resource - which is what a second vantage buys.
falsified: B3's expression (1-b)^2 was wrong; the claim it made is what the data shows
